note.note:
I don’t see the transcript or the DDx JSON included. Please provide both so I can generate the SOAP clinical note.

Required inputs:
- Full raw transcript (doctor–patient conversation).
- DDx JSON (differential diagnosis) produced by the diagnostic agent.

Optional but helpful:
- Any vitals, exam findings, or investigation results if not in the transcript.
- Clarify if there are multiple visits or separate complaints.

When you provide those, I will produce a concise SOAP note following the exact structure and rules you specified.
